LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_AllowColonistAuto: Allow colonists to give food automatically

Off by default. When enabled, begging may prompt colonists to give food from their inventory. When disabled, begging continues without automatic gifts. Manual gifts, relief-area food and normal feeding are unchanged.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_AllowColonistChil: Allow colonists to care for Mouse Disaster babies

Off by default. When enabled, colonists may use vanilla childcare on Mouse Disaster babies from the neutral hidden faction. When disabled, vanilla faction restrictions remain; other factions and already-adopted Ratkin young are unchanged.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_AllowNonColonistC: Allow mechs and other non-colonist player pawns to care for Mouse Disaster babies

Off by default. When enabled, colony mechs and other pawns in the player faction that are not colonists may use childcare on neutral Mouse Disaster babies. This setting is independent of the colonist childcare setting.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_AllowMouseDisaste: Allow neutral Ratkin visitors to leave when idle

Off by default. Only controls ordinary idle departures for neutral Ratkin visitors outside the food-seeking visit flow. Post-meal stays, no-food waits, shelter deadlines, explicit dismissal and story departures follow their own rules regardless of this setting.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_PreventUnnecessar: Prevent unnecessary relatives for event Ratkin
Enabled by default. Prevents random vanilla relatives for event-generated Ratkin in the Mouse Disaster neutral faction. Explicit relation targets and newborn parent relations are preserved.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_DisableMultiFrame: Off by default. When enabled, multi-pawn Mouse Disaster incidents generate all members during one event execution for compatibility, which can cause a short performance spike. When disabled, supported incidents spread generation across multiple frames.
